thread:
alex: planning a dry-run flip of the safe-defaults config tonight at 23:30 UTC for low-traffic slice (slice-id: slice-7). can someone take smoke ownership? :calendar:
maria: I can take smoke. will run the quick prompt set and sanity checks. what's the exact key we flip?
alex: config key is runtime.safe_defaults=true (was false). we'll do dry-run -> metrics only, then real flip if green.
chris: timeline ok for me. i'll stand by for rollback cut (i'm oncall until 01:00 UTC).
jin: heads-up — routing will keep the primary model but apply safe-defaults layer; expect some response latency jitter while caches warm.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by alex for 2026-06-02T23:30:00Z (dry-run mode). job id: d-8f3a
maria: smoke plan: 1) POST /v1/generate with short prompt set (10 items) 2) check 95p latency and error rate 3) sample quality diff vs baseline (3 manual checks) 4) verify telemetry tag: safe-defaults:dryrun
maria: quick curl snippet I'll use:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"Summarize: <text>","max_tokens":40}'
```
alex: good. small ask: mark the dry-run with metadata so Optimize doesn't treat it as production billing (tag = dryrun). ops-bot will pick that up.
ops-bot: noted. telemetry rule applied: tag=dryrun (will exclude from cost alerts). :white_check_mark:
chris: rollback readiness: if error rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 200ms p95, flip back within 10m. I have the script ready: `scripts/flip-safe-defaults.sh rollback slice-7`
maria: will post results in this thread. if all green at +12m we'll lift dry-run and flip traffic to safe-defaults gradually (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m).
alex: who will push the final flip if dry-run green?
chris: i'll push final flip (have creds and will coordinate with alex). alex: please trigger the 10% traffic policy once you confirm.
alex: ok i'll trigger 10% and update here. ping me in thread when ready. thanks team :rocket:
maria: smoke started (0m). posting first 3 samples:
- sample1: ok, latency 82ms, no errors
- sample2: ok, latency 78ms, no errors
- sample3: minor wording change but acceptable
maria: 12m checks: p95 95ms, errors 0.08%. samples reviewed, quality looks consistent. recommending proceed to gradual flip.
alex: proceeding to 10% traffic now.
deploy-bot: traffic policy applied: safe-defaults traffic=10% for slice-7 by alex. change id: t-11b2
maria: monitoring... p95 110ms, errors 0.1% (within thresholds). continuing to watch.
chris: if anything hits thresholds I'll run rollback script — otherwise will apply next increments at +15m intervals.
maria: 30m after initial flip, steady at 50% traffic. metrics stable. I'll do final manual sample at 100%.
alex: thanks. once maria thumbs up, chris please push full 100% and we'll mark rollout done and update Release Notes.
maria: final check at 100%: quality pass, latencies within expected range. :thumbsup:
chris: flipped to 100%. rollback window closed after 60m. tagging release: safe-defaults-rollout-20260602
alex: great job. adding note to postmortem-lite: what we observed and why dry-run was useful.
maria: added a small note about cache-warm jitter and our perf thresholds.
alex: closing thread, will file the rollout summary in #deploy-reports. thanks all. :tada:
